definitions.gloss: confectionery making, producing sweets and pastries
definitions.explanation: The process or business of making confections, sweets, and baked goods. Covers both Japanese confections and Western-style pastries.

examples.japanese: {製菓|せいか}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{製菓|せいか}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My older sister develops new products at a confectionery company.

examples.japanese: {製菓|せいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧し、⟦{帰国|きこく}して→帰国する：21786_kikokusuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: I studied abroad in France to learn confectionery techniques, and opened my own shop after returning to Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
{製菓|せいか} refers specifically to the making or manufacturing of confections and sweets. It is commonly seen in compound words related to the confectionery industry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製菓|せいか}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (confectionery school, pastry school)
- {製菓|せいか}{会社|がいしゃ} (confectionery company)
- {製菓|せいか}{業|ぎょう} (confectionery industry)
- {製菓|せいか}⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧ (confectionery ingredients)
- {製菓|せいか}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for confectionery use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製パン|せいぱん}: bread making, bakery production
- ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧: confections, sweets (the product itself rather than the process)
